name: Port Aransas
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Port Aransas?
answer_short: Yes, with a city golf cart plate. In Port Aransas, a licensed, insured golf cart with lights, reflectors, seat belts and a slow-moving vehicle emblem may use city streets. Carts are prohibited on Hwy 361 south of Avenue G. ATVs and UTVs are not allowed.

golf_cart.roads: City streets with a city golf cart plate

lsv.roads: Roads posted 45 mph or less under state law; the map plans on 35 mph or less

rules.rule: City golf cart license and plate required on public streets; renews each calendar year
rules.citation: Port Aransas Golf Cart Ordinance Art. VIII

rules.rule: Head lamps, tail lamps, reflectors, seat belts, SMV emblem, parking brake, mirror; no engine mods
Carts prohibited on Hwy 361 south of Avenue G
rules.citation: Port Aransas: Golf Cart Laws Strictly Enforced

rules.rule: ATVs and UTVs are not golf carts and are not allowed in city limits, including the beach

faq.q: How much is a Port Aransas golf cart plate?
faq.a: $50 a year for year-round residents and $100 for non-residents; plates expire December 31.

faq.q: Can I drive a UTV or ATV in Port Aransas?
faq.a: No. The city says ATVs and UTVs are not golf carts and are not allowed anywhere in city limits, including the beach.
